annotations.text:
Roadmap 6 - HD wallet

Key screen becomes a choice: New wallet (BIP39 phrase), Restore wallet, or Advanced: single key (what the app does today).

New wallet shows the 12 words once, then makes you fill three back in before it will continue. Restore validates each word against the BIP39 list and can take an optional passphrase.

Once HD, the dashboard's receive address is the next UNUSED one and change goes to a separate internal keychain.

Roadmap 7 + 8

History: an unconfirmed OUTGOING row gets a "Bump fee" button (BDK signals RBF on everything we build). Confirmed and incoming rows show nothing.

Send: amount takes sat or BTC via the unit chips; "Max" fills the spendable balance minus fee. An address that fails validation turns the field red with the reason underneath, and Review stays disabled.

Roadmap item 4 — Transaction history

New "Transactions" card under Unspent outputs: direction arrow (in = green, down; out = up), short txid, signed net amount (sent amounts include the fee), confirmations, relative/short date. Newest first. Click a row → explorer (later).

Keystore flow (roadmap item 1)

Key screen gains "Remember on this device" (OS keychain).
On later launches the app opens on Unlock instead of Key when a wallet is remembered.
Unlock → Wallet. "Use a different key" → Key screen. "Forget this wallet" removes the keychain entry after a confirm.

Warm-minimal refinement of the current app tokens.
Same palette (#FAFAF9 / #1A1A1A / accent #C2410C), 4px radius, 34px controls.
Type: IBM Plex Sans + IBM Plex Mono (tabular numerals for sats).
Addresses/txids are sample values.

MOBILE — iOS + Android (Tauri). 390x844 frames.

Same palette and type as the desktop boards; everything else re-scaled for a thumb: 48px controls, 16px input text (anything smaller makes iOS zoom the page on focus), 12px card radius, 999px chips. Status bar, tab bar and home indicator are drawn in so the real usable height is visible.

Home is a balance card over a transaction list, with a fixed bottom tab bar — Wallet / Scan / Settings. Send and Receive are the two buttons under the balance, not tabs, because they are actions rather than places.

These are ADDITIVE: no desktop screen changes. Labels stay English to match the rest of the app.

Things worth arguing about before I build it:
- Wallet / Scan / Settings as the three tabs, or drop Scan into the Send screen and make the third tab something else?
- M6: BTC as the big number with sats underneath, or the reverse?
- M3: 12 words in two columns fits without scrolling; a 24-word restore will scroll. OK?
- M9 Scan is the only dark screen. Deliberate (camera), or make it light?

What each mobile-only affordance costs

M7 Receive QR — pure JS, no native plugin.
M9 Scan — tauri-plugin-barcode-scanner, camera permission string in Info.plist and AndroidManifest.
M5 Unlock — tauri-plugin-biometric; it authenticates, it does not hold the key, so the key still sits in iOS Keychain / Android Keystore and Face ID gates the read.
M8 Send also opens from a bitcoin: deep link (tauri-plugin-deep-link), prefilled.

M10 'Show recovery phrase' is behind the same biometric gate.
